citeinfo.title: Sediment-Hosted Stratabound Copper Assessment of the Neoproterozoic Roan Group, Central African Copperbelt, Katanga Basin, Democratic Republic of the Congo and Zambia

descript.abstract: This dataset includes polygons that describe permissive tracts for sandstone-type copper deposits in the Central African Copperbelt, Democratic Republic of the Congo and Zambia.
descript.purpose: To delineate where undiscovered deposits of sandstone copper may occur within the upper 2 km of the Earth’s crust. Created for Scientific Investigations Series Report 2010-5090-T, which is part of the USGS assessment of undiscovered copper resources of the world.
descript.supplinf: This dataset was created for the USGS Global Mineral Resource Assessment Project (GMRAP). The primary objectives of the project are to outline the principal areas in the world that have potential for selected undiscovered mineral resources and to estimate the probable amounts of those mineral resources to a depth of 1-3 kilometers below the earth's surface.
